title: The 5 Unwritten Rules of Corporate Survival (That No One Tells You)
description:
CLOCK IN PRE-ORDER IS HERE: https://emilydurham.org/clock-in


Feel like everyone else got the handbook on how to succeed at work except you?  You aren't crazy—there is a hidden game being played, and today we are learning how to win it.
In this video, I’m breaking down the 5 Unwritten Rules of Corporate Survival that HR definitely didn't teach you during orientation. We’re talking about the secret dynamics of office politics, why "just working hard" is actually hurting your career, and how to protect yourself while climbing the ladder.
Consider this your ultimate survival guide to navigating the 9-to-5 world without losing your mind (or your confidence). As your internet big sister, I'm spilling the tea on the hard lessons I had to learn so you don't have to.
